sections.title: Claims and evidence
findings: Proposal document read by reasoning layer: yes

Requested: Fund a 12-month project to create a Governance Incentives Framework for Cardano, including research, data infrastructure, incentive modeling, a controlled pilot, public reporting, and a governance integration pathway.

Deliverables: Governance Incentives Framework and final report, Public governance activity dataset, Public dashboard and documentation, Documented incentive models and formula outputs, Controlled incentive pilot findings report, At least one publication-ready research paper submitted for peer review, Completed and submitted Governance Incentives Framework CIP, Governance integration pathway and governance action submitted to DReps, Final financial and milestone report

Claim (governance, proposer_asserted, high materiality): The proposal states that Cardano currently lacks a structured, data-driven framework for determining how governance contributions should be incentivized, measured, or supported over time.

Claim (governance, independently_verifiable, high materiality): The proposal states that active DReps declined in every 12-epoch period during Cardano's first year of on-chain governance, while voting-power concentration increased.

Claim (governance, independently_verifiable, medium materiality): The Governance Incentives Working Group has created a mapping document identifying 49 relevant efforts, proposals, research papers, tools, and initiatives related to governance incentives.

Claim (governance, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): The project will evaluate candidate incentive mechanisms using research, governance data, modeling, controlled testing, community input, and documented assumptions before presenting adoption decisions to governance.

Claim (governance, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): The proposal says the framework will assess incentive models for participation, decentralization, concentration risk, accountability, gaming risk, shallow compliance behavior, and budget sustainability.
Claim (technical, supported_in_proposal, medium materiality): The project is planned as seven staged milestones over 12 months, with public reviewable outputs at each stage.
missing: Independent evidence for: The proposal states that Cardano currently lacks a structured, data-driven framework for determining how governance contributions should be incentivized, measured, or supported over time.

Independent evidence for: The document states that detailed operational budgeting is maintained separately for audit, administration, and delivery management rather than included in the proposal text.

Independent evidence for: The team claims relevant experience including Governance Incentives Working Group leadership, Cardano Ambassador work, prior Catalyst closeouts, blockchain consulting, and prior reward-design research contributions.
